tools.name: get_ecosystem_snapshot
tools.description: Read current package, player, and dedicated-server totals from s&box watch.

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Find public s&box games, maps, or libraries with live rankings, seven-day and cumulative game playtime, official game-jam membership, and canonical source URLs.

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Read compact details, recent publisher updates, and live-server links for a public game, map, or library.

tools.name: search_organizations
tools.description: Find studios, teams, and creators publishing public s&box games, maps, or libraries.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Read one organization profile with public metadata, aggregate activity, and a bounded package portfolio.

tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Find dedicated s&box servers by name, game, or map with current occupancy and source URLs.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Read the current state and related servers for one s&box dedicated-server ID.

tools.name: get_activity_history
tools.description: Read bounded player history for public games, dedicated servers, or one game. Older aggregate points marked partialCoverage total recorded games and may omit unrecorded games.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_package" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read compact details, official game-jam membership, recent publisher updates, and live-server links for one public s&box package." → after: "Read compact details, recent publisher updates, and live-server links for a public game, map, or library."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
